title: Longest Harmonious Subsequence
description: A harmonious subsequence is formed by deleting zero or more elements without changing the order of the remaining elements, and its maximum value minus minimum value is exactly 1. Given an integer array `nums`, return the largest possible length of a harmonious subsequence. Input: `nums`. Output: that length, or 0 if none exists.
hints: Count how often each value occurs.
Only neighboring integer values can form a harmonious subsequence.
